# Kit 31203 test fixtures

Files here are factual data (text tokens, coordinates, counts and element IDs transcribed from the
pinned instructions PDF) or synthetic data generated by the tests. They are never LEGO artwork:
no page renders and no crops of the instruction images are committed (research R10).

- `page159_words.json`: count (`NNNx`) and element ID tokens on page 159 with their positions in
  PDF points (origin bottom left, y up), as read by pypdf.
- `inventory_expected.json`: the 32 element/quantity pairs of page 159.
- `placements.json`: image placements (pixel size, drawn origin and size in points). `measured`
  holds every image placement on pages 22, 26, 66 and 132 as read by pypdf; `synthetic` covers
  all 40 pinned section pages, generated from the measured locator-panel geometry. Section images
  in tests are rendered synthetically by `tests/unit/tools/synthetic_sections.py`.
